title: 摩根资管：做空美元，日元韩元新台币谁先受益？
speaker: Jason Payne

segments.en: We've been actually short dollar for quite some time already. I think the message today remains that we are still more inclined to maintain that short dollar bias over time.
segments.zh: 我们实际上做空美元已有一段时间。今天的信息仍然是，我们倾向于维持看空美元的立场。

segments.en: So I think within this region, for say, thematically, and I think you guys were touching a bond this when you talk about the yen. I know that we focus on Japan today, but if you dollar over the past two years, right? We've actually seen Taiwan dollar pull at 20 secondary events, right?
segments.zh: 在这个区域，从主题上看，你们谈到日元时触及了这一点。我们今天关注日本，但过去两年，我们看到新台币经历了多次波动。

segments.en: We've seen Korea want to do phenomenally well, and now the question is, well, can you monetize or generate returns by being long yen? I think that is a discussion. But the thematic there is telling the same thing is that basically all the capital that sort of gone into US growth stock, as the markets have started correcting or normalizing, is coming back to capital within that export cycle is coming home to roost.
segments.zh: 我们看到韩元表现强劲，现在的问题是，做多日元能否获利？但主题是相同的：随着市场开始修正或正常化，流入美国成长股的资金正在回流，出口周期的资本正在回流。

segments.en: So what that means is we think that you want to play this sort of capital repatriation or sort of gradual normalization. We think that not only the yen, but Korea want and Taiwan dollar are very attractive currencies to engage in this. So I think to us that's one of the centerpieces that we like to engage in right now.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们认为应该参与这种资本回流或逐步正常化。我们认为不仅日元，韩元和新台币都是非常有吸引力的货币。这是我们目前关注的核心之一。
